house_style: Playful contemporary cartoon illustration for a middle-school English learners tool: bold friendly shapes, expressive faces, bright colors, a light sense of humor, diverse kids. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no border, no frame.

assets.name: island
assets.prompt: A storybook treasure-map style island seen from above in a calm turquoise sea. Spread around the island: a tall snowy mountain peak with dark rain clouds over it in the upper left, an icy bay with small icebergs on the top edge, a green hill under a little rain cloud, a sandy beach with palm trees, a tiny village with a bakery, a small library building, a farm with bean fields and a barn, a fenced ranch with horses, a flower garden full of butterflies, steaming hot springs pools, a tennis court, a calm lagoon, a meadow with pigs, a lighthouse. Lots of space between the places. No text, no labels, no people.
